title: Minecarts with Blocks
description: put a block in a cart! survival friendly!
body:
this pack lets you put a block in a cart! it's very simple, too. simply name a minecart with chest "Minecart with Block" or "Block Minecart" (case-sensitive). the first item in the minecart's inventory (from left to right, top to bottom) will display in the cart. put a non-block item in the first slot and it will turn back into a chest.

naming a cart "Reverse Minecart with Block", "Reverse Block Minecart", "Minecart with Last Block", or "Last Block Minecart" (case-sensitive) will use the last item in the chest's inventory instead. perfect for shift-clicking blocks in!

nearly every block can show up. not just full blocks! experiment and see what you can do with this all new way of decorating!

this pack also supports reskinning chest and furnace minecarts. renaming them "Minecart with <Block>" or "<Block> Minecart" will reskin them to look like other blocks! (e.g. renaming a furnace minecart to "Minecart with Smoker" will make a smoker show up!) this feature is incompatible with the Minecart with Block functionality, and only works with the blocks in the following list.
<details>
<summary>List of available blocks for reskinning</summary>
- Minecarts with Chests -


Trapped Chest

Ender Chest

Copper Chest

Exposed Copper Chest

Weathered Copper Chest

Oxidized Copper Chest


\- Minecarts with Furnaces -

Blast Furnace

Smoker

Campfire

Soul Campfire

All Candle Cakes (format: "<Dye> Candle Cake". leaving it as just Candle Cake will also work.)
</details>
